title: Correcting CondOT: Exact Finite-Step Sampling in Gaussian Flow Matching
abstract: arXiv:2609.39488v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Flow matching generates samples by gradually transforming noise into data. In practice, using a finite number of sampling steps introduces a numerical error that depends on the chosen schedule. We study this dependence for Gaussian targets and the explicit midpoint sampling method, using the exact flow field. We measure sampling error by the squared Wasserstein distance between the target distribution and the final distribution produced by the midpoint sampler. We show that the standard conditional optimal transport (CondOT) schedule cancels the leading midpoint error and improves the general convergence bound, even when the sampling steps are unequally spaced. On a uniform grid of $S$ sampling steps, we fix the signal schedule at $\alpha_t=t$ and prove the existence of scalar noise schedules $\beta_t$ that approach the CondOT noise schedule $1-t$ at rate $1/S$ and yield exact Gaussian sampling for every sufficiently large $S$. translated_title: 修正CondOT：高斯流匹配中的精确有限步采样
translated_abstract: 流匹配通过逐步将噪声变换为数据来生成样本。在实践中，使用有限数量的采样步骤会引入依赖于所选调度的数值误差。我们针对高斯目标分布和显式中点采样方法，使用精确流场研究了这种依赖关系。我们通过目标分布与中点采样器所产生的最终分布之间的平方Wasserstein距离来度量采样误差。我们证明，标准的条件最优传输（CondOT）调度能够消除中点方法的主导误差项，并改进一般收敛界，即使采样步骤间距不相等时也是如此。在具有$S$个采样步骤的均匀网格上，我们将信号调度固定为$\alpha_t=t$，并证明了存在标量噪声调度$\beta_t$，其以$1/S$的速率逼近CondOT噪声调度$1-t$，且对于每个足够大的$S$都能实现精确的高斯采样。
tldr: 本文证明在高斯流匹配中，CondOT调度可消除中点采样的主导误差，且存在以1/S速率逼近CondOT的噪声调度，使得有限步采样即可实现精确的高斯分布采样。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that in Gaussian flow matching, the CondOT schedule cancels the leading midpoint sampling error, and scalar noise schedules approaching CondOT at rate 1/S enable exact Gaussian sampling with finite steps.
